Stanford Researchers Reveal the Brain as Two Ancient Systems Packed Into One Skull
description: Stanford Medicine researchers have discovered that the human brain develops from two distinct progenitor cell lineages rather than a single source. The finding overturns long-held models of brain development and enables new lab models for studying ALS and other brainstem diseases. It also suggests our brain is a composite of two ancient nervous systems joined over evolutionary time.
